players.product: etch (ICP / CCP), PVD / CVD / ALD / epitaxy deposition, vertical-furnace thermal, wet clean and ion implant tools for 3D NAND, DRAM and logic fabs

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 393.53 hundred million, up 30.85%, as the domestic semiconductor equipment market kept rising and localisation accelerated; market share of its etch, deposition, furnace and wet clean tools rose and new products such as ion implant added revenue; integrated-circuit equipment revenue grew more than 50%. Etch equipment revenue and thin-film deposition equipment revenue each exceeded RMB ten billion. Electronic process equipment revenue RMB 36,731,219,888.81 (+32.57%, gross margin 39.18%); electronic components RMB 2,579,277,891.07 (+10.95%, gross margin 52.95%). Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 55.22 hundred million, down 1.77%, because R&D expense rose to RMB 54.35 hundred million (+46.96%), it added 4747 employees and share-incentive costs rose; gross margin fell from 42.93% to 40.10% mainly because component iteration and upgrade costs rose for new products under customer verification. Q4 2025 revenue RMB 12,051,732,762.97; Q4 net profit RMB 391,650,402.16. Batch orders in 2025 came mainly from leading customers in memory, logic and advanced packaging.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 393.53 hundred million (+30.85%); net profit RMB 55.22 hundred million (-1.77%); gross margin 40.10% (42.93% a year earlier)

quarterly_data.signal: Memory (2025 annual report): NAURA's etch, CVD, PVD, thermal, wet clean and plating tools have been adapted to 3D NAND and HBM manufacturing and are on the volume-purchase lists of several leading memory makers, for which it has become a core supplier. In 2025 it launched ion implant and plating tools with its own IP and reached scale volume production of a 12-inch advanced low-pressure CVD silicon vertical furnace; its PVD tool covers logic, memory, specialty and advanced-packaging fabs and reached its 1000th delivered system, and cumulative vertical-furnace shipments passed 1000 units. Its 12-inch wafer-to-wafer and die-to-wafer hybrid bonding tools for HBM, 3D integration and chiplets were formally released in March 2026; the die-to-wafer tool is in industrial application.
quarterly_data.figure: 1000th PVD system delivered; vertical furnace cumulative shipments over 1000

quarterly_data.signal: Acquisitions (2025 annual report): NAURA completed the acquisition of Kingsemi (17.87% stake with a board majority, giving it control), adding front-end and advanced-packaging coater / developer and physical and single-wafer cleaning tools; its subsidiary acquired 90% of Chengdu Guotai Vacuum Equipment, adding optical coating tools for optical lenses and optical communication components. The photovoltaic downturn hurt orders, deliveries, revenue and profit of its vacuum new-energy equipment segment, which it is shifting toward semiconductor-materials, hydrogen and lithium-battery equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: 17.87% stake in Kingsemi; 90% of Chengdu Guotai Vacuum Equipment

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and outlook (2025 annual report): R&D investment RMB 7,277,149,612.81 in 2025, up 34.74%, 18.49% of revenue (34.50% capitalised); R&D staff 6,511 (+42.07%). The company says it will keep focusing on mid- to high-end process nodes and aims to bring product performance to the level of leading international peers, keep its R&D expense ratio stable at a high level, speed up verification and volume production of mid- to high-end process tools, push localisation of core components with domestic suppliers to reduce import dependence, and prioritise long-term orders from leading fabs. It warns that as localisation speeds up, homogeneous competition in mature-node equipment may trigger price wars and pressure selling prices and gross margin, and that export controls on equipment and components affect its overseas supply chain.

Capacity and output (2025 annual report): electronic process equipment production RMB 38,442,876,618.46 (+28.85%) against sales of RMB 36,731,219,888.81 (+32.57%); inventory of such equipment RMB 12,345,123,412.65 (+16.10%). The semiconductor equipment industrialisation base expansion project (phase IV), funded by raised funds, was 60.97% complete at end-2025; the components industrialisation project phase 1 was 100% complete and phase 2 21.79%. Construction in progress RMB 451,779,099.44 (RMB 209,791,288.62 a year earlier).
